Smiti18n runtime, pinned at 7246ba75e36a29ff045ee2fe1073036eb24f009d
https://github.com/Oval-Tutu/smiti18n

The six Lua modules originate from the pinned revision. `init.lua` has one
local compatibility fix: when a locale's plural rule selects an absent form,
use its required `other` form. LICENSE must accompany distributions containing these files.
Upstream sample locales and tests are not shipped in game builds.
